description: This file defines the Bestseller class in an OpenCart module, extending the Product model, and providing a method to retrieve best-selling products with caching.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: Provides functionality to fetch the list of best-selling products, with caching support, within the OpenCart module framework.

methods.name: getBestSellers
